formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∃ x2 ∈ x1.gates[(1 : ℕ)]?.toList, (9 : ℕ) ∈ x2.inputs) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 → (∀ (x4 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), (x1.wires (List.ofFn x4)).getD (9 : ℕ) Bool.false = (x4 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x4 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (9 : ℕ) x1 = fun (x5 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ))) → (16 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size
plain_statement: Petersen graph minus a vertex (edges 0-1, 1-2, 2-3, 3-4, 4-0, 0-5, 1-6, 2-7, 3-8, 5-7, 6-8, 8-5), F its edge function. Every AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two computing F whose first gate (wire 9) equals x_0 AND x_6 and whose second gate lists wire 9 has at least 16 gates.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate AND(x_0, x_6) computes its edge function
